selection.rule: First target in the frozen alphabetical held-out preregistration.

primary_paper.title: Vinardo: A Scoring Function Based on Autodock Vina Improves Scoring, Docking, and Virtual Screening
primary_paper.protocol_location: Methods sections 2.2 and 2.5; virtual-screening results section 3.5
primary_paper.protocol: DUD Release 2; AutoDockTools prepare_receptor4.py and prepare_ligand4.py; bound-ligand-centered box extended 15 A in each dimension; smina; exhaustiveness 32; Vina scoring.
ambiguities: The paper does not report AutoDockTools, Open Babel, or smina versions.
The paper does not report a random seed or complete command line.
Supplementary Table S4 reports BEDROC without alpha; BEDROC20 is the project's explicit alpha=20 inference.
UniDock Vina mode is an accelerated port and is not claimed to be AutoDock Vina or smina equivalent.

box.derivation: Atomic coordinate bounds of targets/ada/xtal-lig.mol2, expanded 15 A on all six faces.

receptor_input_normalization.classification: PDB element-column repair required for AutoDockTools parsing
receptor_input_normalization.trigger: The exact DUD receptor stores the catalytic zinc as atom name/residue ZN but leaves PDB columns 77-78 blank; AutoDockTools otherwise raises 'Could not find atomic number for Z Z'.
receptor_input_normalization.rule: For the single existing ZN atom only, populate the blank element columns with ZN.
receptor_input_normalization.scientific_scope: format annotation only; not target tuning or scoring modification
